name: Times cryptic crossword, Penguin book 10 No 55

clue.text: Man, for example, accepted by theologian as the pattern 5 ears Carmen has divine voice but little craft
Conspirator responsible for the highest rent?
Happy in France to devour coarse biscuit
Gunners trapped in boggy ground or marsh
Blank state produced by ‘Russian Flower’ violin arrangement
Changed daily woman
Chap eating out needs some salt
Wild pigeon race plummeted in America
Vision is feeble — line has disappeared
Playing an hautboy endlessly, the German way
Raising agent to make pointed remark about Olympic finalists
Instrument for long-distance off-peak calls
Boxed jewel at end of a passage?
Trousers, perhaps, not right in this silk
Colourful display of buttons by worker
Creatures much put upon take slippers in case
Like a party under cover?
Left with repairs to Noah’s vessel, found usurer
Way of thinking about an attempt on fourth of July
These turbulent priests could have corns by tea-break!
Teacher’s pet practically
Sculptor nominally welcome in Florence?
Priest with a name for being a lover of lamb, we hear
Regular tunnel not found in Winchester?
Letting oneself down? It can be seen on the face
Trojan hero’s endless curse from outer part of cell
A month to work as an ink-slinger
Senior lady piano-scholar
Stop at sea
House wine receptacle to disappear
Bite crisp biscuit
